name: Francisco Assis - Après le § 81 - Am 32
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2025
part_text: 81a. Regrets that, while Christianity remains the most persecuted religion in the world today, with more than 380 million people affected, there is no European coordinator responsible for combating Christianophobia, even though a coordinator has been appointed to combat Islamophobia;
